answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph, with edge reliability and per-step normalization limiting amplification. A sybil coalition forms an oasis-like cluster separated by a sparse external cut; its low conductance bounds walk escape and, with bounded honest seed mass, min-cut transitivity bounds its reachable stationary mass and aggregate voting weight. Thus influence follows attestations, not arbitrary shale or jade identities.
